scope: source-only; local real-Chromium regressions are NOT hosted acceptance

primary.observed: npm run accept:mgmt:hosted exit 1 at assertHealthy: Fetch.continueRequest Invalid InterceptionId during the 95-route + live-detail crawl; continue-on-error step conclusion success is not a pass

diagnosis.method: Local real Chromium + real HTTPS BFF, 40-95 sequential page.goto(domcontentloaded) crawl with open EventSource and 80-200 overlapping BFF reads per page, run under CPU contention (12 busy loops on 12 cores). Same installPinnedBffBearer, both caller lifecycles (accept-management-hosted-production crawl; probe-route-load-baseline single page) share the helper.
diagnosis.reproduced: Unmodified helper: every false failure was a navigation-cancelled BFF read (e.g. 1893 DIAGABORT records, all replacing=true, detached=false, sameDocument=false, no commit observed yet). Failures reported as net::ERR_ABORTED, not Invalid InterceptionId.
diagnosis.rootCause: Three judgments of an already-causal navigation cancellation were decided by fixed timers instead of by the causal fact they wait for: (1) 25ms after loadingFailed for the replacing navigation's frameNavigated; (2) a 1000ms poll for the same commit in the Invalid InterceptionId proof; (3) 25ms after Playwright's requestfailed for the helper's own CDP loadingFailed record (native tally). Under load the helper's CDP session lags Playwright and the commit trails the cancellation, so timers expire first. Invalid InterceptionId uses interleaving (2); it was demonstrated deterministically (real Chromium events, delivery of Page.frameNavigated deferred in order), not reproduced from the hosted trace.
diagnosis.limit: The hosted trace carries only the first five error strings and the exact hosted Invalid InterceptionId ordering is unproven. Locally, the unforced crawl under load reproduces the sibling false failure (navigation-cancelled reads reported ERR_ABORTED) with the unmodified helper; Invalid InterceptionId is covered only by imposed schedules. No hosted acceptance claim.

change.helper: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs: one per-request causal reading (committed/excused) used by the abort, Playwright-fallback and Invalid InterceptionId paths; unresolved judgments wait for the commit/native record event and are settled by settle() (Performance.getMetrics drain + Page.getFrameTree), never by a timer; 'replacing navigation' now requires the navigation's Document request to precede the cancellation by Chromium timestamp (not arrival order); committed navigations only clear themselves and superseded ones from the in-flight list. Existing cancellation-fact bounded wait (1000ms, rejection-queued events) and canceledAt<=pre-command-sample rule unchanged.
unchanged: live abort/invalid id stays failure after later navigation or closure
no blanket ignore of Invalid InterceptionId or ERR_ABORTED
bearer release scope, tenant, redirect non-disclosure

new: navigation cancelling an abortable BFF read is excused however late its commit reaches the helper (x3)
a live abort is not excused by a later navigation commit; same-URL overlap cannot excuse it (exactly one ERR_ABORTED)
Invalid InterceptionId for a request cancelled by a navigation is proven however late the commit reaches the helper (>1200ms)
a late navigation commit cannot excuse a live invalid protocol id
the helper's own record of a navigation cancellation may trail Playwright's; causality, not arrival, decides (positive + live-abort negative)

p1StaleNavigation.finding: Codex: a Document navigation that failed (HTTP 204, ERR_ABORTED, no commit) stayed in the in-flight list; any later frame commit then made committed(request) true for a live abort that followed it, so a live abort passed as 'cancelled by navigation'.
p1StaleNavigation.fix: Network record carries its type; a failed Document request stamps failedAt on its in-flight entry; the replacing-navigation lookup ignores entries that failed strictly before the cancellation's Chromium timestamp. Causal by timestamp, no timers.
p1StaleNavigation.realBrowserTrace: Reviewer reproducer (204 /stall, live BFF read aborted while page live, 150ms, unrelated goto): trace = Document /stall request -> loadingFailed ERR_ABORTED canceled -> Fetch /pending request -> loadingFailed ERR_ABORTED -> Document /unrelated -> commit. Only opaque ids/method/path. Old head: errors=[] (false green); fixed helper: errors=['GET /pending: net::ERR_ABORTED'] (reproducer reports failure detected).

reviewRound2.p2CausalLimit: The hosted Invalid InterceptionId interleaving still cannot be identified from the first-five-error hosted trace. What is demonstrated: (a) unforced local crawl under load reproduces the sibling false ERR_ABORTED on the af2b helper (cancels judged before the replacing commit arrives) and the repair removes it; (b) Invalid InterceptionId is the same cancel-before-continue mechanism, shown only under imposed schedules. Neither is claimed as the hosted ordering; no hosted acceptance is claimed.
